headline: Ukrainian military strikes Russian air base and drone center in Astrakhan and Oryol
summary: Ukrainian forces confirmed long-range strikes against Russia's Akhtubinsk military airfield housing Su-34 bombers in Astrakhan and a strike drone launch site in the Oryol region.
why: Cross-border military strikes on energy, logistics, and military hubs alter regional risk dynamics in Eastern Europe.

impacts.name: Ukraine
impacts.why: Successful long-range strikes undermine Russian forward military capabilities.
